Minor Roof Repair and Leak Solutions in South Florida

A Small Roof Problem Shouldn’t Become Major Damage

A ceiling stain or minor leak does not always mean you need a new roof. The source may be a localized issue involving damaged shingles or tiles, deteriorated sealant, flashing, a roof penetration, fascia, or nearby area. FB StormX evaluates the visible problem and recommends only the work that is appropriate and within our authorized scope.

We address limited, localized repairs — not full roof replacements or major roofing projects.

Some details

All work is subject to site conditions, local regulations, and confirmation of permit and licensing requirements.

If the problem requires work outside our scope, we will tell you directly instead of recommending a temporary repair that is unlikely to last.

Projects must remain within FB StormX’s authorized scope and below a total value of $2,500.

We do not perform:

  • Full roof replacements or re-roofing.
  • Major or structural roof repairs.
  • Roof decking or truss work.
  • Projects requiring a roofing contractor license or permit.
  • Engineering, code certification, or mold assessment.
  • Whole-roof restoration or waterproofing guarantees.

Catch it before the next storm

A loose tile or a small opening in the flashing is manageable in dry weather. The same opening during a storm can move a large amount of water into your home in a matter of hours. The window to fix it easily is now, not later.

Frequently Asked Questions

There is a stain on my ceiling. Does that mean the roof is leaking?

Not necessarily. Water may enter through the roof, flashing, a penetration, an exterior wall, a window, or another nearby area before appearing on the ceiling. The likely source should be evaluated before recommending a repair.

Do you provide complete roof replacements?

No. FB StormX provides only limited minor repairs that fall within our authorized scope. Full replacements, major repairs, and work requiring a roofing contractor license or permit must be handled by an appropriately licensed contractor.

How quickly can you come?

Response time depends on your location, weather conditions, and current availability. Contact us to request the earliest available appointment.
